NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. It is generated with ./gradlew generatePatchesList for every release. Manually editing this file can break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Pure black backgrounds instead of chess.com's dark grey, in the newer and the older screens. Switch it in Noam's Patches (then restart the app).

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Your own colour in place of chess.com's green, chosen in Noam's Patches → Accent color: buttons, highlights, icons and text of the app.

patches.name: Access Points menu style
patches.description: Lets you switch between the new and legacy Access Points menu styles. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Animation theme
patches.description: The iOS-based app's animation themes: one colour transform over the game's effects (Neon, Gold, Ice, Rainbow and more), with previews and a live preview on the Themes page.

patches.name: Arcade animations
patches.description: Adds the chess.com website's Arcade piece animations to every board: light trails, bursts when a piece is picked up, dropped or captured, a flash on check, outlined last-move squares and animated move hints. Switch it in Noam's Patches.

patches.name: Arrows in games
patches.description: Adds Arrows and Clear buttons to the game bars (live, daily, archived, pass and play, bots, coach). While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move.

patches.name: Block Google IPC
patches.description: Routes every service bind/start, broadcast, activity launch, content-provider access and system-service lookup through a filter that drops anything addressed to Google apps, Google content providers or Google web hosts (GMS, Google app, Android System Intelligence, Google TTS, Play Store, Chrome). Also hands framework classes that bind internally (TextToSpeech) a filtering Context, forces the no-op text classifier and hides the system translation service.

patches.name: Block ads
patches.description: No ad is ever requested or shown; flows that would wait on an ad continue at once. Toggleable in the Mod settings.

patches.name: Block online access
patches.description: Takes away the app's permission to use the internet, so nothing in it (game, ads, analytics) can go online.

patches.name: Block themes
patches.description: The block looks of the iOS-based app (ASCII, Nothing, pixel, neon, glass and more), picked in the Mod settings.

patches.name: Board colors
patches.description: Choose the board's square colours: your own, or one of chess.com's colour themes, on every board of the app. In Noam's Patches → Board colors.

patches.name: Change emoji size
patches.description: Enables Gboard's emoji size setting. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Clipboard Custom Character Limit
patches.description: Lets you set the maximum number of characters stored for each text clipboard item, with Gboard's stock 20,000-character limit as the default. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Close Proactive Suggestions
patches.description: Shows a dismiss button in the proactive suggestions bar. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Colour theme
patches.description: The iOS-based app's colour themes for the game screen (OLED, Midnight, Candy and more), picked with previews on the Mod settings Themes page.

patches.name: Customize Home screen
patches.description: Choose which tiles and sections the Home screen shows, and the order of the tiles. Works on both of chess.com's Home screens (the older list and the redesign).

patches.name: Customize bottom bar
patches.description: Choose the tabs between Home and More (Puzzles, Learn, Watch, Bots, Train) and their order, in Noam's Patches → Bottom bar.

patches.name: Debug log
patches.description: Writes the screens the game opens to files/bbmod.log in the app's data (for troubleshooting the patches).

patches.name: Disable Google Play services
patches.description: Makes Gboard's Play services availability check always report SERVICE_MISSING, so GMS-backed code paths (Clearcut logging, Phenotype, federated learning, sign-in, feedback) are skipped instead of retried.

patches.name: Disable impossible levels
patches.description: Replace impossible Classic trays with a playable three-piece sequence. Works with Android and iOS generation; toggleable in Mod settings.

options.title: Disable impossible levels
options.description: Require a way to place all three pieces, including line clears between moves.

patches.name: Disable revive
patches.description: A Classic game ends at game over without the revive offer, as in the iOS-based app.

patches.name: Disable screen shake
patches.description: Adds a screen-shake toggle to the Mod settings, off to start with.

patches.name: Drag speed
patches.description: How far a held piece moves for each finger movement, on every screen size.

options.title: Drag ratio
options.description: 1.5 is what the iOS game uses.

patches.name: Enable Inline Autofill Suggestions
patches.description: Enables inline autofill suggestions in supported contexts. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Enable cursor trackpad mode
patches.description: Enables the long-press-spacebar trackpad, cursor lock mode, and the required scrub-move preference. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Extra effects
patches.description: The iOS-based app's seven extra effects: magnet drag, particles, landing bounce, big-clear flash, score pulse, thumbs-up and touch haptics. All off by default, toggled in Mod settings.

patches.name: Fake best score
patches.description: Show a chosen number as the Classic best score; the real record keeps tracking underneath and comes back when the option is turned off. Set in Mod settings.

patches.name: Faster game over
patches.description: The result screen opens as soon as the board has filled, without the extra wait.

patches.name: Fix signature self-check
patches.description: Gboard verifies that its own APK is signed by Google and refuses to start otherwise. This lets the check pass for Gboard's own package only; other packages are still checked, so no Google app is ever trusted by the patched keyboard.

patches.name: Fresh Classic games
patches.description: Every new Classic game starts on an empty board in the original skin, and the tutorial is skipped.

options.title: Empty board
options.description: No pre-filled cells at the start of a game.

options.title: Original skin
options.description: Go back to the original look when a game starts (all-clears change the skin during a game).

options.title: Skip the tutorial
options.description: A fresh install starts with a normal game instead of the scripted tutorial.

patches.name: GIF providers
patches.description: Brings the GIF tab back without giving Gboard network access: Gboard's Tenor (Google) requests and GIF downloads are answered from the GIF sources chosen in No-Google settings (KLIPY, GIPHY, nekos.best, Wikimedia Commons, Openverse) through the separate network helper app (included: the GIF tab offers to install it), which can only reach those sites. Off until a GIF source is chosen.

patches.name: Hide Premium-only content
patches.description: Free accounts no longer see what only Premium members can use: Premium-only bots are not listed, and the Premium toolbar button, the Home and More banners and the Settings Upgrade row, the Home diamond, the sale banner and More's Membership row are gone. Nothing is unlocked.

patches.name: Hide percent-of-players popups
patches.description: Hides the "you defeat X% of players" fail animation and the chapter top-rank badge. Toggleable in Mod settings.

options.title: Hide "% of players" messages
options.description: The Adventure defeat percent and the top-rank badge.

patches.name: Key Shape Selection
patches.description: Enables the Key shape option inside theme details without forcing rounded keys by default. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Keyboard stays left-to-right
patches.description: Right-to-left languages (Hebrew, Arabic…) change only the letters on the keys: the toolbar, suggestions and keys are not mirrored and the keyboard's menus stay in the phone's language. Switched in No-Google settings → Keyboard.

patches.name: Limits as toasts
patches.description: When a free limit is reached (Game Review, puzzles, lessons, drills, videos…) a short toast says so instead of a full-screen Premium offer, and promotional pop-ups are not shown. Nothing is unlocked: the limits stay exactly as they are.

patches.name: Login days
patches.description: The score multiplier uses a fixed number of login days instead of counting the days you open the game.

options.title: Login days
options.description: Clears score 1 + log10(days) + 1/(1 + days mod 10) times the base (1 day: x1.5, 10 days: x3).

patches.name: Menu theme
patches.description: The iOS-based app's menu themes for the home screen; Original follows the colour theme. Picked with previews on the Mod settings Themes page.

patches.name: No ads
patches.description: Banner, full-screen and game-over ads are not loaded or shown, and neither are their Remove Ads links: the app's own "ads enabled" state and the account's show-ads flag, which are off for members, stay off.

patches.name: No rating prompts
patches.description: The app doesn't ask you to rate it on Google Play. Switch it in Noam's Patches.

patches.name: No-Google settings
patches.description: Adds a "No-Google" entry to Gboard's settings with switches for every runtime patch: blocking categories, Play services, GIF sources and the sticker tab, keyboard direction, offline voice typing (engine, model, threads, auto stop), offline translation (engine), model downloads and import, and a log of blocked calls.

patches.name: Noam's Patches settings
patches.description: Adds a Noam's Patches row at the top of the More tab, where the other patches of this bundle are switched on and off. Patches you did not select do not show up there.

patches.name: Offline translation
patches.description: Replaces Google Translate in Gboard's translate panel with on-device models: Tencent Hy-MT (LLM, llama.cpp) for quality, with Firefox Translations (Bergamot, slimt) shown instantly while Hy-MT works; the panel's texts say so instead of naming Google Translate. Models are read from the app's models folder.

patches.name: Offline voice typing
patches.description: Replaces Gboard's voice typing (Google servers / Google app) with on-device Whisper (whisper.cpp) in the keyboard's current language. Phrases are transcribed while you talk and typed when you tap Done; ACFT models only encode the recorded audio, so they are several times faster. Models are downloaded in No-Google settings (through the network helper app) or copied into the app's models folder.

patches.name: Package rename
patches.description: Renames the package so the patched keyboard installs alongside (instead of over) the system Gboard, which keeps Google's signature. Also drops split-APK requirements so a merged APK installs on its own.

options.title: Package name
options.description: Package name of the patched keyboard.

patches.name: Quick Insert
patches.description: Enables the Quick Insert panel and toolbar access point. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: Remove Google components
patches.description: Removes receivers and services that Play services, Phenotype or Pixel apps call into, the federated-learning (Brella) training and example-store services, the exported web debug bridge, Google package visibility <queries>, Google metadata, and disables Android cloud backup (which uploads app data to Google Drive).

patches.name: Remove network access
patches.description: Removes the INTERNET permission (plus account and Google-service permissions). Without it the kernel refuses to create any network socket for the app, so neither Gboard's Java code nor its native libraries can reach any server. Language packs, GIFs, stickers, cloud voice typing and other online features stop working.

patches.name: Remove startup credits
patches.description: Removes the Hungry Studio wordmark from the boot splash (the activity window background shown while the engine loads), leaving its plain gradient until the loading screen appears.

patches.name: Review on Lichess
patches.description: Game Review opens your game on Lichess (imported, with Lichess's analysis board) in a browser inside the app: always, or only once chess.com's free review is used up.

patches.name: Runtime feature toggles
patches.description: Lets the No-Google settings turn off Gboard features that only work through Google servers (Emoji Kitchen, Tenor, Assistant voice, proofread…) and hide the GIF and sticker tabs.

patches.name: Tidy settings menu
patches.description: More games becomes the game's own Back-to-home button (and More games is gone everywhere), and the default-skin row hides itself while the patches' own themes are in use. Toggleable in the Mod settings.

options.title: More games becomes Back to home
options.description: Starting state of the toggle in the Mod settings.

patches.name: Time controls under a minute
patches.description: The custom time slider goes below one minute: 10, 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds, with or without increment, the way the website allows. Labels read "30 sec" and "0:30+1".

patches.name: Top Toolbar Item Count
patches.description: Lets you customize the top toolbar item count. Ported from jasonwu1994/Gboard-patches (GPLv3).

patches.name: iOS generation algorithm
patches.description: Classic trays are dealt by the real iOS 7.4.3 game code, which runs inside the app and plays along with every move; Android's own algorithm is skipped. Toggleable in the Mod settings.
